name: Practice
overview: Scripture teaches that consistent practice rooted in faith and reliance on God leads to spiritual growth and strength. Training and guiding others in the right way, as Proverbs 22:6 encourages, establishes a foundation that endures throughout life. Believers are called to live by faith in Christ, allowing His life to work through them (Galatians 2:20), and to cultivate the fruit of the Spirit such as love, peace, and goodness (Galatians 5:22). The principle of sowing and reaping (Galatians 6:7) underscores that the outcomes of one's practices align with their actions, while Isaiah 40:31 and Luke 1:37 remind us that trusting in the Lord renews strength and makes the impossible possible.
